entries.title: Psalms 16:1
segments: ¶<<Michtam of David.>> Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

words.text: : for in thee do I put my trust

entries.title: Psalms 16:2
segments: [O my soul], thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou [art] my Lord: my goodness [extendeth] not to thee;

entries.title: Psalms 16:3
segments: [But] to the saints that [are] in the earth, and [to] the excellent, in whom [is] all my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 16:4
segments: Their sorrows shall be multiplied [that] hasten [after] another [god]: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips. {hasten...: or, give gifts to another}

entries.title: Psalms 16:5
segments: The LORD [is] the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot. {of mine...: Heb. of my part}

entries.title: Psalms 16:6
segments: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant [places]; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 16:7
segments: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

entries.title: Psalms 16:8
segments: ¶I have set the LORD always before me: because [he is] at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

words.text: before me: because [he is] at my right hand

entries.title: Psalms 16:9
segments: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope. {rest...: Heb. dwell confidently}

entries.title: Psalms 16:10
segments: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 16:11
segments: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence [is] fulness of joy; at thy right hand [there are] pleasures for evermore.
